name: Fyndiq
description: Fyndiq Merchants API (shared with CDON) for Nordic marketplace sellers: orders with fulfilment and tracking, receipts, articles with price and stock per market, processing statuses and categories. Merchant ID and token.
instructions:
## Fyndiq
This connector works with the **CDON Group Merchants API** at `https://merchants-api.fyndiq.se/api`, the API Fyndiq shares with its sister marketplace CDON, for merchants selling on Fyndiq in the Nordics: orders with fulfilment and tracking, receipts, articles with price and stock, processing statuses and categories.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in to your Fyndiq merchant account.
2. Open your profile or account settings and find the API or platform integration section with your **merchant ID** and **API token**.
3. Copy the merchant ID into `FYNDIQ_MERCHANT_ID` and the token into `FYNDIQ_TOKEN`.

If you cannot find them, ask Fyndiq merchant support (seller@fyndiq.com) for your Merchants API credentials. The connector sends both as HTTP Basic auth (merchant id as user name, token as password). Credentials are per marketplace: a Fyndiq token does not work on CDON, which has its own connector.

**Where to start**: `fyndiq_list_orders` returns the new orders (state CREATED). `fyndiq_list_articles` shows your catalogue with stock and prices; `fyndiq_get_article_by_sku` finds one article by your SKU.

**Orders**: each order holds exactly one SKU, with a quantity that can be above one; `price` and `total_price` are for the whole quantity. States: CREATED (new), ACCEPTED (not available to every merchant), FULFILLED (shipped, final) and NOT_FULFILLED (cancelled and refunded, final). Read with `fyndiq_list_orders` and `fyndiq_get_order`, ship with `fyndiq_fulfill_order` and the tracking numbers, and fetch the receipt link with `fyndiq_get_order_receipt`. `fyndiq_accept_order` is only for merchants with the accepted step. `fyndiq_cancel_order` is installed switched off: cancelling refunds the customer and cannot be undone. There is no messaging and no returns call in this API.

**Articles**: an article is one sellable unit with its own SKU (a colour and size), grouped into a product by `parent_sku`. Reads (`fyndiq_list_articles`, `fyndiq_get_article`, `fyndiq_get_article_by_sku`) return prices as `price[].value.amount` (decimal string). Writes go through the bulk endpoint and take prices as `amount_including_vat` (number) with `currency` and an optional `vat_rate`: `fyndiq_create_article`, `fyndiq_update_article` (always send status, main_image, markets, shipping_time, title and description), `fyndiq_update_article_price` and `fyndiq_update_article_quantity`. `fyndiq_delete_article` and `fyndiq_bulk_update_articles` (up to 100 actions in one call) are installed switched off.

**Asynchronous writes**: article writes answer 202 with a `batch_id` and are processed in the background, market by market. Check the outcome with `fyndiq_get_batch_statuses` or `fyndiq_get_sku_statuses`: status ok, failed or pending, with an error code such as invalid_category or sku_already_exists.

**Markets, currencies, languages**: SE (SEK, sv-SE), DK (DKK, da-DK), FI (EUR, fi-FI) and NO (NOK, nb-NO); en-US is accepted for texts. Which markets are open to you depends on your merchant agreement. `fyndiq_list_categories` returns the category tree per market and language.

**Not on Fyndiq**: shipping configurations, the carrier service catalogue and the payment reports of the Merchants API exist on CDON only, so this connector has no tools for them. The connector never moves money.

**Paging**: orders and articles take `limit` (up to 1000) and `page` from 1; a page with fewer rows than limit is the last one.

**Rate limits**: 9,000 calls per minute and 270,000 per hour. A 429 carries `X-RateLimit-Policy-Violated` (burst or quota) and the reset time as a UNIX timestamp in `X-RateLimit-Burst-Reset` or `X-RateLimit-Quota-Reset`; rejected calls count too, so wait instead of retrying at once.

**Dates and ids**: times are ISO 8601; order and article ids are strings. Fields that have no value must be left out, not sent empty.

FYNDIQ_MERCHANT_ID.label: Merchant ID
FYNDIQ_MERCHANT_ID.help: Your Fyndiq merchant ID, shown with the API token in your Fyndiq merchant account, or sent by Fyndiq merchant support.
FYNDIQ_MERCHANT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the merchant ID only (letters, digits and dashes), without spaces.

FYNDIQ_TOKEN.label: API token
FYNDIQ_TOKEN.help: The Merchants API token of your Fyndiq account. A CDON token does not work here.
FYNDIQ_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the token only, without spaces.

verifyHints.400: Fyndiq refused the request; the answer names the field that is wrong.
verifyHints.401: Fyndiq did not accept this merchant ID and token. Copy both again; credentials are issued per marketplace, so CDON credentials do not work on Fyndiq.
verifyHints.403: Fyndiq refused the call: these credentials have no permission for this resource.
verifyHints.404: Fyndiq found no order or article with that id.
verifyHints.422: Fyndiq could not process the body; the answer lists the fields that failed.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Fyndiq allows 9,000 calls per minute and 270,000 per hour. Wait until the time in X-RateLimit-Burst-Reset or X-RateLimit-Quota-Reset.

prerequisites: A Fyndiq merchant account and its Merchants API credentials (merchant ID and token); Fyndiq merchant support issues them when they are not shown in the account. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: fyndiq_list_orders
tools.description: List Fyndiq orders, new ones (state CREATED) by default: id, customer_order_id, article_id, article_sku, title, quantity, price and total_price (amount for the whole quantity with vat_amount, vat_rate and currency), market, state, shipping_address (name, street, postal code, city, country, phone), created_at, updated_at, fulfillment_deadline, tracking_information and receipt_available. Each order holds one SKU; `price` is for the whole quantity, not per unit. 100 rows per page (max 1000); a page with fewer rows than limit is the last. Read-only.

state.description: CREATED (new, default), ACCEPTED, FULFILLED (shipped) or NOT_FULFILLED (cancelled and refunded).

tools.name: fyndiq_get_order
tools.description: Read one Fyndiq order: id, customer_order_id, article_id, article_sku, title, quantity, price and total_price (amount for the whole quantity with vat_amount, vat_rate and currency), market, state, shipping_address (name, street, postal code, city, country, phone), created_at, updated_at, fulfillment_deadline, tracking_information and receipt_available. Amounts are in the customer's local currency. Read-only.

tools.name: fyndiq_accept_order
tools.description: Accept one new order (state CREATED to ACCEPTED), which commits you to deliver within the agreed time. The accepted step is not available to every merchant; where it is not, go straight to fyndiq_fulfill_order. An accepted order can no longer be cancelled through the API. Answers 202 with a short description.

tools.name: fyndiq_fulfill_order
tools.description: Mark one order as shipped (state FULFILLED, final), with the tracking numbers of the parcels when you have them. Do this as soon as the item has left; a cancelled order cannot be fulfilled. Answers 202 with a short description.

carrier_name.description: Carrier name, e.g. Postnord, DHL, Budbee. Optional.

tracking_information.description: Parcels, e.g. `[{"carrier_name": "Postnord", "tracking_number": "abc123"}]`. Leave out when there is no tracking.

tools.name: fyndiq_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel one order you cannot ship (state NOT_FULFILLED, final). Fyndiq refunds the customer and the cancellation cannot be undone. Only new orders can be cancelled, not accepted or fulfilled ones. Installed switched off. Answers 202 with a short description.

tools.name: fyndiq_get_order_receipt
tools.description: Get a download link (`download_url`) to the receipt PDF of one order. The link expires about 10 minutes after it is issued, so fetch it only when it is needed. Works only when the order has receipt_available true; older orders and orders fulfilled moments ago have none. Read-only.

tools.name: fyndiq_list_articles
tools.description: List the articles (one per SKU) of your Fyndiq account: id, sku, parent_sku, status (for sale or paused), quantity, title and description per language, brand, gtin, categories, main_image, images, markets, price and original_price per market (amount as a decimal string and currency), shipping_time, delivery_type and properties. 100 rows per page (max 1000); a page with fewer rows than limit is the last. Read-only.

for_sale.description: true: only articles with status `for sale`. Default false (all).

tools.name: fyndiq_get_article
tools.description: Read one article by its Fyndiq article id: id, sku, parent_sku, status (for sale or paused), quantity, title and description per language, brand, gtin, categories, main_image, images, markets, price and original_price per market (amount as a decimal string and currency), shipping_time, delivery_type and properties. Read-only.

article_id.description: Fyndiq article id (id of fyndiq_list_articles, or the id returned when the article was created).

tools.name: fyndiq_get_article_by_sku
tools.description: Read one article by your own SKU. The article sits under `content.article` in the answer: id, sku, parent_sku, status (for sale or paused), quantity, title and description per language, brand, gtin, categories, main_image, images, markets, price and original_price per market (amount as a decimal string and currency), shipping_time, delivery_type and properties. Read-only.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

tools.name: fyndiq_create_article
tools.description: Create one article (one sellable unit with its own SKU) on Fyndiq. Required: sku, status, quantity, main_image, markets, price, shipping_time, title and description. Processed in the background: the answer has `batch_id`, `success` (id and sku) and `failed` (errors per field); check how it landed per market with fyndiq_get_sku_statuses.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

market.description: Market code: SE (Sweden), DK (Denmark), FI (Finland) or NO (Norway).

amount_including_vat.description: Price including VAT as a decimal number, e.g. 349 or 349.50.

currency.description: Currency of the market: SEK for SE, DKK for DK, EUR for FI, NOK for NO.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 25. Left out, the standard rate of the market applies.

price.description: One price per market the article is sold in.

status.description: `for sale` or `paused` (hidden from customers, kept in the account).

main_image.description: Public URL of the main image.

market.description: Market code: SE (Sweden), DK (Denmark), FI (Finland) or NO (Norway).

language.description: Language code: sv-SE, en-US, da-DK, fi-FI or nb-NO.

title.description: Title per language, e.g. `[{"language": "sv-SE", "value": "Röd t-shirt, storlek M"}]`. Missing local languages are translated by the marketplace.

language.description: Language code: sv-SE, en-US, da-DK, fi-FI or nb-NO.

description.description: Description per language, same shape as title.

parent_sku.description: Group id that ties the variants (sizes, colours) of one product together; the main article uses its own SKU.

category.description: Category id as text, e.g. `1124` (id of fyndiq_list_categories).

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name, up to 50 characters.

properties.description: Properties as name and value, e.g. `[{"name": "color", "value": "Deep Green", "language": "en-US"}, {"name": "preset-size_SML", "value": "xxl"}]`. Free-text properties (color, material, size and others) need a language; preset- properties take a fixed value.

variational_properties.description: Names of the properties that tell the variants of a group apart, e.g. `["color", "size"]`.

delivery_type.description: Delivery method per market: mailbox, service_point or home_delivery, e.g. `[{"market": "SE", "value": "mailbox"}]`.

shipped_from.description: Where the goods ship from: EU or NON_EU.

internal_note.description: Your own note, up to 60 characters; not shown to customers.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer and EU responsible person (GPSR), e.g. `{"name": "Acme AB", "address": {"street_address": "Storgatan 1", "city": "Malmö", "postal_code": "21122", "country": "SE"}, "website": "https://acme.example", "email": "info@acme.example", "responsible_person": {"name": "...", "phone": "...", "email": "..."}}`.

tools.name: fyndiq_update_article
tools.description: Replace the content of one article by SKU (titles, descriptions, images, markets, delivery times, status and the optional fields). Status, main_image, markets, shipping_time, title and description must always be sent, also when unchanged. Price and stock have their own tools. Processed in the background; check the outcome with fyndiq_get_batch_statuses or fyndiq_get_sku_statuses.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

status.description: `for sale` or `paused` (hidden from customers, kept in the account).

main_image.description: Public URL of the main image.

market.description: Market code: SE (Sweden), DK (Denmark), FI (Finland) or NO (Norway).

language.description: Language code: sv-SE, en-US, da-DK, fi-FI or nb-NO.

title.description: Title per language, e.g. `[{"language": "sv-SE", "value": "Röd t-shirt, storlek M"}]`. Missing local languages are translated by the marketplace.

language.description: Language code: sv-SE, en-US, da-DK, fi-FI or nb-NO.

description.description: Description per language, same shape as title.

parent_sku.description: Group id that ties the variants (sizes, colours) of one product together; the main article uses its own SKU.

category.description: Category id as text, e.g. `1124` (id of fyndiq_list_categories).

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name, up to 50 characters.

properties.description: Properties as name and value, e.g. `[{"name": "color", "value": "Deep Green", "language": "en-US"}, {"name": "preset-size_SML", "value": "xxl"}]`. Free-text properties (color, material, size and others) need a language; preset- properties take a fixed value.

variational_properties.description: Names of the properties that tell the variants of a group apart, e.g. `["color", "size"]`.

delivery_type.description: Delivery method per market: mailbox, service_point or home_delivery, e.g. `[{"market": "SE", "value": "mailbox"}]`.

shipped_from.description: Where the goods ship from: EU or NON_EU.

internal_note.description: Your own note, up to 60 characters; not shown to customers.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer and EU responsible person (GPSR), e.g. `{"name": "Acme AB", "address": {"street_address": "Storgatan 1", "city": "Malmö", "postal_code": "21122", "country": "SE"}, "website": "https://acme.example", "email": "info@acme.example", "responsible_person": {"name": "...", "phone": "...", "email": "..."}}`.

article.description: The new content of the article.

tools.name: fyndiq_update_article_price
tools.description: Set the price of one article by SKU, per market, including VAT, in the currency of the market (SEK, DKK, EUR for Finland, NOK). Markets left out keep their price. Processed in the background; the answer has `batch_id`, `success` and `failed`, and fyndiq_get_sku_statuses shows the result per market.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

market.description: Market code: SE (Sweden), DK (Denmark), FI (Finland) or NO (Norway).

amount_including_vat.description: Price including VAT as a decimal number, e.g. 349 or 349.50.

currency.description: Currency of the market: SEK for SE, DKK for DK, EUR for FI, NOK for NO.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 25. Left out, the standard rate of the market applies.

tools.name: fyndiq_update_article_quantity
tools.description: Set the stock quantity of one article by SKU (0 to 500000; 0 means sold out). Processed in the background; the answer has `batch_id`, `success` and `failed`, and fyndiq_get_sku_statuses shows the result.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

tools.name: fyndiq_delete_article
tools.description: Delete one article by SKU: it is removed from Fyndiq and customers no longer see it. To stop selling for a while, set its status to paused with fyndiq_update_article instead. Installed switched off. Processed in the background; the answer has `batch_id`, `success` and `failed`.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

tools.name: fyndiq_bulk_update_articles
tools.description: Send up to 100 article actions in one call: update_article, update_article_price, update_article_quantity or delete_article, each with a sku and its body. One wrong row changes or deletes the wrong article, so it is installed switched off; the single-article tools cover everyday changes. Answers `batch_id`, `success` and `failed`; follow up with fyndiq_get_batch_statuses.

sku.description: Your SKU of the article, 1 to 64 characters.

action.description: What to do with the article.

body.description: Fields for the action: the article content for update_article, `price` for update_article_price, `quantity` for update_article_quantity; none for delete_article.

tools.name: fyndiq_get_batch_statuses
tools.description: Read how the article changes of one or more batches were processed: per batch the statuses[] with sku, article_id, action and, per market, status (ok, failed, pending) and error_code (for example invalid_category, invalid_vat_rate, sku_already_exists, update_not_allowed). Read-only (a POST that only reads).

batch_ids.description: Batch ids (`batch_id` of a create or update answer).

tools.name: fyndiq_get_sku_statuses
tools.description: Read the latest processing status of articles by SKU: per SKU and market status (ok, failed, pending) and error_code. It shows the last change that was processed; a change sent a moment ago may still be on its way. Read-only (a POST that only reads).

tools.name: fyndiq_list_categories
tools.description: Read the Fyndiq category tree for one market, with names in one language: id (the category value of an article), name, path (ancestor ids joined by dots) and search_friendly_name. A long list. Read-only.

market.description: Market code: SE (Sweden), DK (Denmark), FI (Finland) or NO (Norway).

language.description: Language of the names: sv-SE, en-US, da-DK, fi-FI or nb-NO.
